article.story: RIVERSIDE, Calif. -- — Mike Price had 29 points in Chicago State’s 81-62 win over Cal Baptist on Wednesday. Price shot 10 for 16 (7 for 12 from 3-point range) and 2 of 3 from the free-throw line for the Cougars (2-2). Will Lovings-Watts scored 18 points and added six rebounds. Rene D’Amelio finished with 18 points and nine rebounds for the Lancers (0-3). Cal Baptist also got 15 points and two steals from Justas Stonkus. Terry Coner Jr. had 13 points, six assists and two steals. Up next Both teams play Friday. Chicago State visits San Diego and Cal Baptist plays UAPB at home. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
